reviewer.identity: OMP reviewer subagent Def40AdversarialReview (self-reported model anthropic/claude-fable-5)
reviewer.independence: Separate agent context. It did not author the corpus, loader or tests, and it was read-only on the repository. It was spawned by the implementing session, so it is not a separate human or organisation; this is recorded as a self-review limitation.

commands: 29-case loader tamper battery on /tmp copies -> 25 rejected; 4 accepted (DEF40-R1 x3, DEF40-R3)

server battery: 127.0.0.1-only bind; 404 for manifest/artifact/traversal/query paths; 501 for HEAD/POST/OPTIONS; 16-slot concurrency with no semaphore leak across two 24-connection floods; clean SIGTERM shutdown

smoke falsification: served-body hash mismatch, label confusion in both directions, redirect target change, span shift and wrong final source were all detected; a relocated tampered corpus made validate/smoke exit 1

findings.summary: Some verdict flips on the same-name and stale trap labels were missed by the loader and tests: 3 of 6 went undetected.
findings.fix: Added test_trap_fixtures_keep_their_negative_verdicts, which pins all 6 non-accepted labels.
findings.disposition: RESOLVED, re-verified: all 6 flips caught and the pristine corpus passes. Mutation M5 in mutation-check.json.

findings.summary: The top-level smoke passed field does not count NOT_RUN_BROWSER results.
findings.fix: The report now lists not_run_browser_cases, and the claim states that passed covers HTTP cases only. Browser evidence is in browser-proof.json.

findings.summary: The loader accepted orphan observations that no expected entry cited.
findings.fix: load_manifest now rejects them with 'orphan observation'; a mutation test was added.
findings.disposition: RESOLVED, re-verified on redirect-body and uncited-200 tampers

findings.summary: Values on kind=text observations are free-form summaries and are not checked against the quote.
findings.disposition: ACCEPTED-AS-DOCUMENTED. Known limitation that must be revisited before any locked-benchmark promotion.
